description: Hand-labelled relevance of each resume to each job description, used to score retrieval accuracy. Labels were written from the resume and JD text before running the matcher, so they do not reflect its output.

rubric.2: Strong match: meets every stated minimum (years and required stack) and the core of the role.
rubric.1: Partial match: meets the stated minimum years and much of the required stack, or works in an adjacent role a recruiter would still shortlist.
rubric.0: Not a match, including anyone below a stated minimum years requirement. Any resume not listed under a job description is grade 0.

usage: Treat grade >= 1 as relevant for precision@k, recall@k and MRR, and use the grades themselves for nDCG. Keys are job_descriptions/<key>.txt; resume_path matches the resume_path field the matcher returns.
